title: Country with the biggest basket
statementMd:
Which customer country has the highest average order value (orders with items, non-cancelled)? Show country and the average rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `country`, `avg_order`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Per-order totals, then average by country.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH t AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.id) SELECT c.country, ROUND(AVG(t.total), 2) AS avg_order FROM t JOIN customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY AVG(t.total) DESC LIMIT 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
